_comment: Names in Corgo's 77 Collection Mooks (data/npcs/) that do not match an item by name. 'aliases' maps a stat block's name to the item's: a name, {name, note} where the note goes on the NPC, or {by_parent: {printed parent: name}} for a part whose item depends on what it is installed in. 'unbuilt' names what has no Foundry item, with the reason; the NPC's notes carry it instead. 'skills' fixes skill-name typos. tools/build_npcs.py fails on any name in none of these, and on an 'unbuilt' entry no stat block uses.
